fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to bind all servers. Default value: false. Valid values:

true: yes
false: no
fields.help_zh:
是否全量绑定。默认false，取值：

true：是
false：否
fields.name: bind_all

fields.help_en:
The protection edition of Security Center to bind. Valid values:  
1: Free Edition 
3: Enterprise Edition
5: Advanced Edition
6: Anti-virus Edition    
7: Ultimate Edition
fields.help_zh:
需要绑定的云安全中心防护版本。 取值：  
1：免费版 
3：企业版
5：高级版
6：防病毒版    
7：旗舰版
fields.name: version

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable automatic binding for new assets. Valid values:

0: disabled
1: enabled
parameters.help_zh:
开启新增资产自动绑定。取值：

0：关闭
1：开启
parameters.name: auto_bind

parameters.help_en:
The edition to automatically bind when new assets are added. Valid values:
1: Free Edition 
3: Enterprise Edition
5: Advanced Edition
6: Anti-virus Edition    
7: Ultimate Edition
parameters.help_zh:
新增资产时自动绑定的版本，取值：
1：免费版 
3：企业版
5：高级版
6：防病毒版    
7：旗舰版
parameters.name: auto_bind_version

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to forcibly upgrade the edition
parameters.name: update_if_necessary

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. Different requests must use different tokens. The token supports only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 客户端 Token，用于保证请求幂等性。不同请求应使用不同的 Token；只支持 ASCII 字符，长度不超过 64 个字符
parameters.name: client_token

BindCount.description_en: The number of servers that are successfully bound

RequestId.description_en: The request ID, which is a unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request. You can use this ID to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题

ResultCode.description_en:
The binding result status code. Valid values:

0: Success.
1: Parameter error.
2: Insufficient server authorization quota.
3: Insufficient server authorization core quota.
4: Pay-as-you-go billing is not activated.
5: Service suspended due to overdue payment.
6: Serverless protection is not enabled.
7: Pay-as-you-go host and container security service is not activated.
-1: Binding exception
